SELECT DISTINCT T.DOMAIN_ID , T.COMPANY_CD , T.TASK_ID , T.TASK_NM , T.TASK_DETAIL , SF_GET_CODE_NM('ko-KR', 'CM001', T.TASK_STATE_CD, T.COMPANY_CD, T.DOMAIN_ID) AS TASK_STATE , T.TASK_START_DT , T.TASK_END_DT , SF_GET_CODE_NM('ko-KR', 'CM002', T.TASK_IMPORTANCE_CD, T.COMPANY_CD, T.DOMAIN_ID) AS TASK_IMPORTANCE , T.TASK_OWNER_MEMBER_ID , T.TASK_PROGRESS , T.CHILD_TASK_ADD_YN , C.COMPANY_NM EMP_COMPANY_NM , E.EMP_NM , TE.TASK_EMP_CD , SF_GET_CODE_NM('ko-KR', 'CM004', TE.TASK_EMP_CD, T.COMPANY_CD, T.DOMAIN_ID) AS TASK_EMP , TT.TASK_NM AS PARENT_TASK_NM , T.PARENT_TASK_ID , 'Y' AS CHILD_YN , T.TASK_TYPE_CD , SF_GET_CODE_NM('ko-KR', 'CM007', T.TASK_TYPE_CD, T.COMPANY_CD, T.DOMAIN_ID) AS TASK_TYPE_NM FROM TASK_MASTER T INNER JOIN TASK_EMP TE ON (TE.TASK_ID = T.TASK_ID AND TE.DOMAIN_ID = T.DOMAIN_ID) LEFT JOIN EMP_MASTER E ON (E.EMAIL = T.TASK_OWNER_MEMBER_ID AND E.DOMAIN_ID = T.DOMAIN_ID AND E.COMPANY_CD = T.COMPANY_CD) INNER JOIN COMPANY_MASTER C ON (C.DOMAIN_ID = E.DOMAIN_ID AND C.COMPANY_CD = E.COMPANY_CD) LEFT JOIN TASK_MASTER TT ON (TT.TASK_ID = T.PARENT_TASK_ID AND TT.DOMAIN_ID = T.DOMAIN_ID AND TT.COMPANY_CD = T.COMPANY_CD) LEFT JOIN TASK_LABEL TL ON (TL.TASK_ID = T.TASK_ID AND TL.DOMAIN_ID = T.DOMAIN_ID)
T.DOMAIN_ID = #{domainId} AND T.CHILD_TASK_ADD_YN = 'N' AND T.PARENT_TASK_ID = #{taskId} AND (T.DEL_YN = 'N' OR T.DEL_YN IS NULL)
GROUP BY T.TASK_ID ORDER BY CASE WHEN T.TASK_END_DT is NULL THEN '2' WHEN T.TASK_END_DT = '' THEN '1' ELSE '0' END, T.TASK_END_DT, T.TASK_IMPORTANCE_CD, COALESCE(T.PARENT_TASK_ID, T.TASK_ID), T.PARENT_TASK_ID IS NOT NULL, T.TASK_ID
